_note: All safety wording for Lost & Found, in one place for counselor review. General rules only; calm, never frightening.

ask.en: You can't see Mama! What do you do first?
You can't see Papa in the busy market! What do you do first?

outside.en: Walk out to the street to look

ask.en: The fiesta is so busy, and you can't see Lola! What do you do first?
You can't see Tito by the umbrellas! What do you do first?

outside.en: Walk far down the beach to look

ask.en: The crowd is so big, and you can't see Ate! What do you do first?

outside.en: Go out of the gate to look

text.en: Stop and stay close to where I am

why.en: Yes! When you stop and stay close by, your family can find you faster. Next, look for a safe helper.

text.en: Run around looking everywhere

why.en: Running around makes it harder for your family to find you.

outsideWhy.en: Going away from here takes you farther from your family.

why.en: Guards work here and can call your parent.
Cashiers work here. They can call the info desk for you.
The people at the info desk work here. They can call your family.

name.en: a worker with a name tag

why.en: An apron and a name tag mean this person works here and can help you.
A mom or dad with children is a safe helper too.
Police officers keep people safe and can help you find your family.
Lifeguards work at the beach and can help you find your family.

shopper.en: They might be nice, but look for someone who WORKS here — like a guard or a cashier.

extraHelper.en: Yes, {name} can help too! For this mission, find the helpers on the list.

empty.en: Keep looking for someone who works here.

text.en: Someone you don't know says they'll take you outside to find your parent. What is the best choice?
Say no, stay inside, and go to the info desk or a guard

why.en: Right! Say no and stay inside. Workers like a guard or the info desk can call your family.

text.en: Go outside with them

why.en: Never go anywhere with someone you don't know, even if they seem kind. Stay inside and find a worker.

text.en: Wait outside by the door alone

why.en: Outside is farther from your family. Stay inside and go to a guard or the info desk.

text.en: Your family has a secret family password. What is it for?
So I can tell if a grown-up was really sent by my family

why.en: Yes! If someone says your family sent them but doesn't know the password, say no, go, and tell a trusted adult.

text.en: To tell anyone who asks for it

why.en: The password is a secret for your family only. Don't tell it to others.

text.en: To unlock the doors of the mall

why.en: A family password is a secret word that only your family knows, to keep you safe.

text.en: Someone you don't know asks you to come and see some puppies. What do you do?
Say NO, go away, and tell a trusted adult

why.en: That's it: No, Go, Tell! You can always say no and go to a trusted adult.

text.en: Go quickly to see the puppies

why.en: Don't go anywhere with someone you don't know. Say no, go away, and tell a trusted adult.

text.en: Keep it a secret

why.en: Never keep this kind of thing a secret. Telling a trusted adult keeps you safe.

text.en: Your family is going to a busy place. What can you plan before you go in?
A meeting spot, like the info desk, in case we get separated

why.en: Great plan! A meeting spot helps your family find you fast.

text.en: Nothing, we will figure it out later

why.en: Planning first makes it easier. Pick a meeting spot, like the info desk.

text.en: To meet in the parking lot by myself

why.en: The parking lot has cars and is far away. A meeting spot inside, like the info desk, is safer.

text.en: A guard asks for your parent's phone number so they can call. What helps most?
Say the number I practised at home

why.en: Yes! Practise your parent's number at home, so you can tell a safe helper.

text.en: Walk away to find a phone myself

why.en: Stay with the safe helper. They can call your family for you.

text.en: Say nothing and wait

why.en: It's okay to talk to a safe helper. Tell them your name and your parent's number.

text.en: A worker is helping you, and your family is on the way. What do you do now?
Stay with the worker until my family comes

why.en: Right! Stay put with the safe helper. Your family knows where to find you.

text.en: Go off to look for them again

why.en: If you walk away, your family may miss you. Stay with the helper.

text.en: Leave with the first grown-up who waves

why.en: Only go with your own family, or someone they really sent. Stay with the helper.
